figures.name: Amaterasu

ability.name: Dawn Return
ability.description: Return from the cave: restore all light buffs and deal 5 damage to all dark enemies.

figures.description: The great sun goddess who withdrew into a cave plunging the world into darkness before being lured out by laughter.

figures.name: Susanoo

ability.name: Orochi Slayer
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one giant-type enemy; find and equip divine sword Kusanagi.

figures.description: Storm god exiled from heaven who slew the eight-headed serpent Yamata-no-Orochi and composed the first waka poem.

figures.name: Izanagi

ability.name: Purification Rite
ability.description: Remove all pollution and death-curse effects; grant +2 to all purified allies.

figures.description: Male creator god who formed Japan and escaped the underworld, purifying himself to birth sun, moon and storm.

figures.name: Izanami

ability.name: Death Curse
ability.description: Mark one enemy for death: they take 2 additional damage from all sources for 3 turns.

figures.description: Female creator goddess who died in childbirth and became queen of the underworld, threatening 1000 deaths per day.

figures.name: Tsukuyomi

ability.name: Night Division
ability.description: All allies on the night side gain +2 to all stats; day and night cannot coexist this turn.

figures.description: The moon god who killed the food goddess and was forever separated from Amaterasu creating day and night.

figures.name: Raijin

ability.name: Thunder Drums
ability.description: Deal 4 thunder damage to all enemies; inflict deafening stun on all struck for 1 turn.

figures.description: The thunder god who beats his ring of drums to create thunder and lightning storms across Japan.

figures.name: Fujin

ability.name: Wind Release
ability.description: Grant all allies +4 speed for 1 turn; disperse all stationary effects on the field.

figures.description: The wind god who carries the winds of the world in his great bag and releases them to drive ships and storms.

figures.name: Inari

ability.name: Fox Messenger
ability.description: Summon one divine fox ally with 6/6/8/8/7 stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: The kami of rice, foxes and prosperity whose shrine messengers are foxes (kitsune) carrying sacred scrolls.

figures.name: Yamata-no-Orochi

ability.name: Eight Simultaneous Strikes
ability.description: Attack 8 different targets dealing 1 damage each; each attack ignores a different defense.

figures.description: The monstrous eight-headed serpent who demanded maiden sacrifices until tricked by sake and slain by Susanoo.

figures.name: Kagutsuchi

ability.name: Birthing Fire
ability.description: Deal 5 fire damage to all enemies; when this card is destroyed it births fire spirits.

figures.description: The fire deity whose birth burned his mother Izanami fatally, causing Izanagi's rage and the first death.

figures.name: Benzaiten

ability.name: Divine Biwa
ability.description: Play music: all enemy abilities requiring combat are suppressed for 1 turn.

figures.description: Goddess of arts, music and sea who plays the biwa lute and is the only female of the Seven Lucky Gods.

figures.name: Ebisu

ability.name: Lucky Catch
ability.description: Steal one resource buff from any enemy; grant it to the ally with the lowest stats.

figures.description: The jolly god of fishermen and commerce who is hard of hearing, one of the beloved Seven Lucky Gods.

figures.name: Tengu

ability.name: Mountain Mastery
ability.description: Grant one ally mastery of all physical abilities: +3 power and speed for 2 turns.

figures.description: The winged mountain demons who teach martial arts to worthy humans and punish the arrogant.

figures.name: Kappa

ability.name: Water Depression
ability.description: Drain 2 HP from one enemy; if they bow, drain 3 more as the water spills.

figures.description: The river sprite who drags victims underwater but can be stopped by bowing — making it bow and spilling its head water.

figures.name: Oni

ability.name: Club Smash
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to one enemy; remove one positive effect from them.

figures.description: The horned Japanese demon with iron club who punishes sinners in hell and is driven away on Setsubun.

figures.name: Tanuki

ability.name: Belly Drum Magic
ability.description: Create one illusion ally that fools enemies for 2 turns before vanishing.

figures.description: The magical raccoon dog who shapeshifts into treasure and humans, beating his leaf-covered belly for luck.

figures.name: Yuki-onna

ability.name: Frozen Breath
ability.description: Freeze one enemy for 2 turns; they cannot act or be warmed by any ally.

figures.description: The beautiful snow spirit whose breath freezes travelers solid and whose kiss brings cold death on winter mountains.

figures.name: Fudo Myo-o

ability.name: Immovable Flame
ability.description: This card cannot be moved, pushed or repositioned; deal 4 fire damage per turn to all dark enemies.

figures.description: The immovable wisdom king surrounded by flames who destroys evil with his rope and sword.

figures.name: Benten

ability.name: Lake Shrine
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; all water and music abilities gain +2 power.

figures.description: The lake-dwelling form of Benzaiten whose shrines sit on islands in sacred lakes.

figures.name: Ame-no-Uzume

ability.name: Ecstatic Dance
ability.description: Make all allies laugh: remove all fear and paralysis effects; inflict confusion on all enemies.

figures.description: The dawn goddess whose lewd comic dance lured all the gods to laughter and drew Amaterasu from her cave.
